enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Assassinate +8: +8 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Insightful Deception +6: +6 Insight bonus to hit and +9 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.

Enhanced Bloodrage: This weapon is enhanced by blood - your blood! Each time you take damage or kill an enemy, there is a small chance that you will fall into an unholy bloodrage, greatly increasing your Melee Power, Constitution, and Damage. However, this rage will leave you more vulnerable to Physical attacks, slightly reducing your Armor Class.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
